blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Filipino-American skateboarder Jericho Francisco Jr. finished fourth in the men’s park final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Friday, scoring 84.41 points and missing the bronze medal by 1.62 points. Japan’s Izuru Nagahara won gold with 88.96 points, followed by Chinese Taipei’s Ku Yong-yan with 87.33. Japan’s Gunjo Shiji secured bronze with 86.03. Francisco, 24, nevertheless left Aichi Sky Expo satisfied after entering the competition with limited preparation and few expectations. “I am beyond happy with my performance.
